boardFeatures.title: Simple mode
boardFeatures.intro: Switch off what this board does not need; other boards are not affected. Switching something off hides it and keeps its data. Changes here apply immediately.
boardFeatures.offForServer: Switched off for the whole server, in the server settings.

board.loadFailed: Failed to load the board settings

boardNotifications.intro: The update feeds that post about this board. Each follows its own settings from the server's notifications until you change something here, for this board only. Changes save straight away.
boardNotifications.noFeeds: No feed posts about this board. Server managers add feeds in the server's settings.

threads.title: Task threads
threads.intro: Give each task its own thread for discussion, in one of this board's update feed channels. A thread follows its task's title and is archived when the task is deleted or archived. The feed's updates about the task, including new comments, are posted in it as you choose below; messages written in the thread stay in Discord. Changes save straight away.
threads.noFeed: This board has no update feed yet. Add one in the server's notification settings, or with /kanbancord feed in Discord, then switch threads on here.
threads.notWorking: On, but not working: the chosen channel no longer has a feed for this board. Choose another feed channel.
threads.perTaskHint: Each task gets its thread when something next happens to it.
threads.channelWithoutFeed: A channel without a feed for this board
threads.privateNotPossible: Not possible in this channel: private threads need a text channel where the bot may create private threads.
threads.privateHint: Only the task's creator and assignees are in the thread, plus server moderators. New assignees are added.
threads.cannotMake: The bot cannot make threads in #{channel}, so tasks get no new threads. Give it View Channel, Send Messages in Threads and Create Public Threads there, or choose another channel.
threads.cannotMakePrivate: The bot cannot make private threads in #{channel}, so tasks get no new threads. Give it View Channel, Send Messages in Threads and Create Private Threads there, or choose another channel.

labels.intro: Labels this board's tasks can be tagged with. Changes here apply immediately.
labels.name: Label name
labels.deleteUsage_one: It will be removed from the {count} task using it.
labels.deleteUsage_other: It will be removed from the {count} tasks using it.

priorities.title: Priorities
priorities.intro: Priority levels, most urgent first. A task has at most one. Changes here apply immediately.
priorities.none: No priority levels. Tasks on this board have no priority.
priorities.name: Priority name
priorities.newPlaceholder: New level, added at the bottom
priorities.deleteUsage_one: The {count} task with this priority will have none.
priorities.deleteUsage_other: The {count} tasks with this priority will have none.

features.intro: Simple mode keeps boards to the essentials: columns, and tasks with a title and description. Switch on only what this server needs. Switching something off hides it and keeps its data.
features.customFirst: Turn custom permissions off first: their rules are kept for when you switch back.
features.openHint: Everyone who can talk in this server may create, change, move and delete columns, tasks, labels and priority levels, whatever their roles. Managing the server, board permissions, deleting or archiving boards and the audit log stay with its managers.
features.confirm: Everyone who can talk in this server will be able to create, change, move and delete columns, tasks, labels and priority levels, whatever their roles. Best for a small group that trusts each other.

transfer.exportIntro: Download this board as a file, to keep a copy or to import it as a new board, here or in another server. Its details, columns and tasks are always in it.
transfer.exportFailed: The board could not be exported
transfer.exportInActivity: Files cannot be downloaded inside Discord. Export the board on the website instead.
transfer.importIntro: Create a new board from a file exported from KanbanCord. Its details, columns and tasks always come along.
transfer.notAFile: This is not a KanbanCord board file.
transfer.name: Name of the new board
transfer.importFailed: The board could not be imported

skipped.assignees: Assignees left out, as they are not in this server: {count}
skipped.roles: Role assignments left out, as the roles are not in this server: {count}
skipped.permissions: Permission rules left out, about someone not in this server or more than you may set: {count}
skipped.commentAuthors: Comments by people not in this server, now posted by you and naming who wrote them: {count}
